text: Learning a new skill can be exciting, but it also takes time and effort. First, you need to practise regularly, even if it is only for a short time each day. Patience is just as important, because progress is often slow at the beginning. There are many resources you can use, such as online videos, books, or courses, so choose what suits you best. It also helps to track your progress, for example by keeping a diary or setting small goals. Finally, stay motivated by reminding yourself why you started and celebrating each step forward.
